entities.name: Reaper King
entities.description: A legendary scarecrow of Shadowmoor, once its most powerful, now spreading blight to reclaim its broken kingdom.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Whose death preceded the Reaper's diminishment.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event whose end melded Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

events.summary: The end of the Great Aurora and the melding of the planes cost the Reaper King much of its domain and control of the scarecrows.
events.quote: caused the Reaper King to loose much of its domain and its control over the scarecrows of Shadowmoor
